SIGNALS.name: The Hacker News
SIGNALS.summary: Microsoft says a malicious extension version (2.1.313) never reached its VS Code Marketplace; Cursor rotated keys and rebuilt its marketplace. How attackers published under Anthropic's name is unclear.

SIGNALS.name: Anthropic
SIGNALS.summary: Anthropic describes research on automating red-teaming for subtle emergent misalignment, tasking thousands of Claude agents with evading a training data monitor.

SIGNALS.name: AGTP
SIGNALS.summary: Cites the Financial Times: OpenAI has cut its funding target to about $20 billion from $30 billion, with a lower target valuation.

SIGNALS.name: Arena
SIGNALS.summary: Arena reports Gemini 4 Carbon (High) placed first in Text Arena, second in Agent Arena and fourth in Code Arena WebDev.

SIGNALS.name: *Walter Bloomberg
SIGNALS.summary: Nikkei is cited as reporting that Japan has asked Anthropic and OpenAI for more access to their advanced AI models.

SIGNALS.name: Layton Gott
SIGNALS.summary: Unconfirmed leaks suggest a GPT-6.2 release could come this weekend, citing a rumored internal model name and a new image model appearing in OpenAI API docs.
